title: Merchant Mariners of World War II Congressional Gold Medal Act of 2020
official_summary:
Merchant Mariners of World War II Congressional Gold Medal Act of 2020

This bill provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to be awarded to the U.S. Merchant Mariners of World War II, in recognition of their service during World War II.

Following the award of the medal, it shall be given to the American Merchant Marine Museum, where it shall be available for display and research.

summary.headline: Public Law 116-125 authorizes a Congressional Gold Medal to honor U.S. Merchant Mariners of World War II and sends the medal to the American Merchant Marine Museum for display.
summary.what_it_does: The law provides for a Congressional Gold Medal to recognize the service of U.S. Merchant Mariners during World War II. After the medal is awarded, it goes to the American Merchant Marine Museum, where it can be displayed and used for research.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was enacted on March 13, 2020.
